purpose: Convert legitimate service revenue into confirmed BTC reserve sats without agent custody.

paymentPolicy.preferredSettlement: BTC directly to the published SATA reserve address
paymentPolicy.quoteRule: Each invoice must include an exact sats amount, quote source, quote timestamp, and expiration before it is sent to a customer.
paymentPolicy.custodyRule: No agent may receive funds, hold keys, or redirect payments away from the published reserve address.
paymentPolicy.deliveryRule: Deliver service work only after payment confirmation or chairman-approved escrow terms.

invoices.deliverable: One-page public-readiness audit covering token authorities, liquidity lock, reserve claims, and disclosure gaps.
postPaymentActions: record transaction id in sats-generation-ledger.json receipts
regenerate transparency report so confirmed reserve sats update publicly
invoices.publicDisclosure: Service revenue may be paid directly into the BTC reserve. No price guarantee, no redemption promise, no revenue guarantee, and no market-support commitment.

prohibitedInvoicePatterns: fake engagement, bots, raids, or investor lists
price, profit, return, redemption, liquidity, or market-support promise
